title: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file
description: We built NariQ: 3-bit-or-lower quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B that retain near-BF16 quality across agentic tasks, math, multilingual reasoning, and image understanding. To our knowledge, this is the first 3-bit-or-lower quantization that retains BF16 lvl performance on long-horizon agentic tasks. Benchmarks (BF16 / 3-bit / 2.5-bit / 2-bit): - DeepSWE: 39.8 / 41.0 / 41.9 / 28.6 - Terminal-Bench 2.1: 62.6 / 63.8 / 60.2 / 52.4 - AIME 25+26: 97.7 / 98.3 / 96.5 / 86.0 - MSGM: 94.0 / 93.1 / 91.8 / 90.6
